title: GhostHotbar
description: Hide Your Hotbar, Show It Only When Needed
body:
Hide your hotbar by default. Show it temporarily with a key or when picking up important items.

## What GhostHotbar Does:

- Hides your hotbar by default to reduce visual clutter.
- Shows it temporarily when you press a key (e.g., H) or pick up an item in the hotbar.
- Automatically hides the hotbar after a set duration (3–4 seconds).
- Resets the timer each time a new item enters the hotbar.
- Shows the hotbar when opening your Inventory and hides it again when closing.

## Configurable Options:

- **keyShowHotbar** → Key to show the hotbar (default H)
- **showDuration** → Time in seconds the hotbar stays visible (default 3–4)
- **resetOnPickup** → true/false, whether picking up a new hotbar item resets the timer
- **showDuringInventory** → true/false, hotbar always visible while Inventory is open
- **enableHotbarHide** → true/false, enable/disable the hiding feature completely

### Why Use GhostHotbar:

1. Reduces distractions and lets you focus on gameplay.
1. Only shows the hotbar when needed, giving a cleaner interface.
1. Perfect for pairing with SmartSlot: GhostHotbar handles visibility while SmartSlot automatically selects items, giving full control without visual clutter.

### Gameplay Benefits:

- Cleaner HUD, more focus.
- Faster reactions with no unnecessary visual noise.
- Keeps hotbar management smart and simple while maintaining full control over your items.
